name: Boots of Walken
description:
These magnificent leather boots give you advantage on Charisma (Performance) checks provided you speak in a… halting, uneven cadence with an unpredictable… emphasis on, random words. 

(2 charges)

name: Hat of Butterflies
description:
Can emit a flutter of butterflies. 

 (3x a day)

name: Toad in a Jar
description: Seems like an ordinary toad in a jar.

name: Fake Doorknob
description: A magical doorknob that, when pressed against a flat surface, creates a door. The door looks to be the style of other nearby doors. Opening the door reveals the wall behind it that it was placed on, leading nowhere, for it is a fake door.

name: Whistle of Duck Summoning
description: Summons a regular duck. It is always the same duck.

name: Book of Monster Essence
description: A book detailing how to extract monster essence for item crafting use.
